sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A production seamless TILE ATLAS for a top-down 2D coastal pixel RPG inspired by the clear chunky pixel craft of Back to the Dawn. Square 1536x1536 canvas, precisely 3 columns and 3 rows of EQUAL 512x512 texture tiles, tiles TOUCH edge to edge, NO gutters NO borders NO labels NO words NO objects NO people NO perspective, flat overhead orthographic ground plane. Each cell depicts a seamless repeatable 32x32 logical pixel tile enlarged exactly with hard square pixels, consistent small palette and pixel grid. Row1: muted olive grass; warm gray rectangular coastal stone paving; desaturated brown horizontal wooden dock planks. Row2: pale sandy shore ground; deep muted teal seawater with a few small restrained wave highlights; earthy brown compact dirt ground. Row3: horizontal pale stone stair treads, parallel across whole tile; warm brown horizontal cafe wooden floor planks; dark gray workshop square stone floor. Uniform soft top-left daylight, ground surfaces unobtrusive low contrast to keep actors legible. No shadows cast by unseen objects, no outlines around tiles, no decorative vignettes, no patchwork within a cell. Not a scene and not a terrain transition atlas; exactly nine continuous texture swatches.

sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset for a top-down 2D pixel RPG with the spatial readability and pixel craft of Back to the Dawn, but ORIGINAL warm coastal island architecture. Fixed three-quarter overhead, orthographic parallel projection, vertical walls, horizontal front edges, visible object tops. Crisp deliberately chunky square pixel clusters, limited warm stone/teal roof/olive plant/blue shadow palette, restrained detail, NO painterly smooth gradients, NO antialiasing, NO perspective convergence, NO characters, NO words, NO UI. A TRUE transparent PNG sprite atlas. Precisely 3 equal columns and 3 equal rows, 9 cells in row-major order. Square canvas preferably 1536x1536. Each complete object centered in its cell with generous transparent gutters on every side. No object crosses a cell boundary, no labels, no grid lines, no contact sheet background. Consistent light from upper left. Each object independently usable in Godot with a ground-contact anchor near its bottom; no external cast shadows or ground bases. Nine sprites: row1 col1 cozy seaside cafe building with slate teal tiled pitched roof, cream plaster facade, single front door and warm windows, simple coffee-cup hanging icon WITHOUT text; row1 col2 compact blue-gray wooden stage prop workshop building with roof, large front double doors and small high window; row1 col3 two-story cream dormitory facade with blue roof and single front door. Row2 col1 small pale stone lighthouse with blue roof and red door, full structure; row2 col2 small wooden harbor registration kiosk with teal roof and open service window; row2 col3 full broadleaf coastal tree with rounded olive canopy and visible brown trunk, transparent between leaves and below canopy. Row3 col1 horizontal wooden park bench; row3 col2 full dark metal streetlamp with small warm lamp; row3 col3 short horizontal wooden waterfront railing with three posts. All 9 ground objects isolated completely from each other. Buildings are viewed from same front-facing high three-quarter angle as interiors of Back to the Dawn, not diamond isometric. This is a parts sheet, not a finished map.

sources.prompt: Use case: style-transfer and game sprite production. The attached image is an IDENTITY/COSTUME reference only. Completely redraw this same young human man as a crisp small pixel RPG overworld character in the readable chunky pixel craft of Back to the Dawn. Preserve brown tousled hair, brown short jacket, pale shirt, dark blue trousers, brown boots, olive cross-body satchel. Friendly compact 3.5-head proportions, not an anime portrait. Generate a TRUE TRANSPARENT square sprite atlas exactly 4 equal columns by 4 equal rows, preferably1536x1536. Each cell one COMPLETE full-body character with feet on exactly the same baseline, same body size and centered anchor. Row1 four WALKING frames facing SOUTH towards viewer; row2 four WALKING frames facing WEST left; row3 four WALKING frames facing EAST right; row4 four WALKING frames facing NORTH away from viewer. Four columns form left foot forward / passing / right foot forward / passing. Arms swing oppositely, satchel consistent side, feet planted correctly. Fixed three-quarter overhead parallel orthographic RPG angle; see top of head subtly. Each sprite should read as native 32x48 pixel artwork enlarged with crisp square pixels, carefully chosen limited palette, NO gradients, NO soft edges, NO antialiasing, no painterly texture. Generous empty transparent gutters around each sprite, sprites do not overlap cells. No shadows, no floor, no extra objects, no text or labels, no grid lines. The reference's high-resolution shading must be replaced with coherent low-resolution pixel clusters.

Top-right: Lin Qiao, young woman with short black bob hair, white shirt and dark green cafe apron, dark pants. Bottom-left: Uncle Chen, older man with short gray hair and rectangular glasses, navy vest, pale short-sleeve shirt, clipboard. Bottom-right: Lu Cen, young black-haired male technician, dark gray workwear, brown belt tool pouch. All looking generally SOUTH toward viewer, fixed three-quarter overhead orthographic game perspective showing a little head top; relaxed neutral idle stance. Match body height across all four; strong readable outfit silhouettes and simple faces. Crisp hard-edged pixel clusters, limited unified olive/teal/navy/brown/cream palette, no painterly texture, no gradients, no antialiasing, no shadows, no background or floor, no text, no labels, no cell borders. Do not reuse detailed illustration; redraw as small game sprites.
